items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: It wasn't Ramping Ma Rainey, but it put him in the mind.

ctx.x: That's Bessie Smith. I know it. Bessie Smith's like that. I know it. I know it. Bessie Smith's like that. I know it too. Yeah. Her too, huh? Yeah. Where did you see her? What town would that be? That's Newport, Rhode Island. I saw her. Oh, that's late years, huh? Yeah. I saw the one what I'm talkin' bout.
Oh, that's late years, huh? Yeah. I thought it wasn't what I'm talking about. It wasn't Ramping Ma Rainey, but it put him in the mind.

Oh, I know who he's talking about. Is it Mahaney? No, it's a white woman, huh? What's that? Is that a white woman that tries to sing like Ma Rainey in them? No, she was calling. Oh, I don't know who it would be then. Why are there so many of them?
